notes.title: Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]Get your survival skills ready - Frost Survival VR is OUT NOW!🎉[/h3][p][/p][p]Hello Hunters!
 
We are happy to announce that our new game [b]Frost Survival VR [/b]has just launched on Steam! 

Frost Survival VR is a sandbox survival set in a frozen wilderness. Face a frozen wilderness solo or in co-op - build a shelter, craft tools, hunt for food, and manage your resources to endure harsh conditions. Strategize your moves against unpredictable weather and lurking dangers. And remember to keep yourself safe and sane![/p][p][/p][h3]Play the game now![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054950/Frost_Survival_VR/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We encourage you to join our community on [url="https://discord.gg/wenklystudio"]Discord[/url], and follow us on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wenklystudio"]TikTok[/url], X and [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/FrostSurvivalVR/"]Reddit[/url].[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]Needs & Survival 🏹[/b][/h3][p]Isolated from the rest of the world, you must rely on your own wits and limited resources to survive harsh conditions in this [b]Sandbox Survival. [/b]Your main goal is to stay alive, but how?[/p][p][b]Build your Base[/b]: Build a shelter to escape the frost and replenish vital strengths.[/p][p][b]Tools & Weapons[/b]: To survive and fully exploit your surroundings, you will need a variety of tools.[/p][p][b]Hunt, Craft & Gather[/b]: Hunt wild animals to gain food and resources.[/p][h3][b]Winter & Wilderness❄️[/b][/h3][p]Surviving isn't easy. Strategizing your moves is crucial to staying alive. Complete essential tasks during daylight and be aware of the darkness, as nighttime brings [b]lower temperatures[/b]. [b]Weather conditions[/b] are unpredictable and change dynamically, so always be prepared!  Explore a [b]huge map[/b], but remember that not every place is safe; some may be inaccessible based on your current gear.[/p][h3][b]Safe & Sane 👾[/b][/h3][p]Survival isn’t just about staying alive; it’s also about [b]staying sane[/b]. How do you keep your humanity in this frozen hell?[/p][p]In Frost Survival VR, you must take care of not only your physiological needs, such as hunger, thirst, and keeping yourself warm, but also your [b]mental health[/b]. If you neglect it, reality may start to blur with illusion. [b]Fake sounds[/b] and [b]creatures[/b] will make survival even more challenging. But beware - some figments of your imagination can harm you![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Multiplayer Experience👥[/b][/h3][p]Try to survive [b]alone[/b] or [b]cooperate[/b] with others in a multiplayer experience.[/p][p]Do you like playing alone? Don’t worry, there are some uncovered secrets scattered across the frozen wilderness that will help you endure. Or you can work together with other players: gather resources, insulate your shelter, and defend against threats like cold, hunger, and dangerous animals. [b]Shape your survival sandbox experience your way![/b][/p][p][img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/public/shared/images/responsive/youtube_16x9_placeholder.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Weapon attachments and more! The new update is live! 🚀
notes.notes:
Hello Hunters! 👨‍🚀

[b]Weapon attachments are here! [/b]
Today's update introduces long-awaited weapon attachments. From now on you can customize your weapons with barrel accessories, sights and lasers. 

Besides, we have a number of improvements for you. According to your requests, Motherships created manually will now become more "private".
On top of that, we have worked on a few aspects of looting to make it more enjoyable.

More details below:

[b]🔥New Features🔥[/b]

🔹Added Weapon attachments

[b]🚀Improvements🚀[/b]

🔹PvE Linked Maps: Mothership is now linked to Volcano on PvE if server was created manually. (No changes on PvPvE)
🔹PvPvE Mothership created manually no longer can be joined using "Random ship"
🔹Changed spawn positions/rotations of items to feel more natural
🔹Made changes to destroyable chests, so particles will be less likely to obscure items
🔹Changed sound and increased speed of force grabbing

[b]🛠️Fixes🛠️[/b]

🔹Typos in location names.
🔹Double-handed issues with the Vortex Rifle.
🔹Max capacity screen display at the evac capsule.
🔹Air Drop indicator overlapping the airdrop and players.
🔹Incorrect descriptions when applying mods to weapons.
🔹Various crafting issues.
🔹Player respawn issues on the Mothership.
🔹Flickering texts on crafting stations.

notes.title: Astro Hunters VR is officially OUT now! 🚀
notes.notes:
[h2]Astro Hunters VR is AVAILABLE on Steam🎉[/h2]


Hello Hunters! 👨‍🚀
We’re thrilled to announce that the Astro Hunters VR is now available on Steam. Become one of the mercenaries and help the Mothership. We’re waiting for you! But remember there are also other hunters on the planet. Will you ally, fight, or betray - it's up to you!🚀

We would like to thank you for your incredible support throughout the game's development. We're grateful for your feedback and all your kind words. 🥰

Astro Hunters VR is a PvPvE [b]Extraction Shooter[/b] set in space. Immerse yourself in the exploration a unique planet, fight with different enemies, craft, gather resources, and upgrade your weapons. 

To celebrate the launch, we have a fantastic offer for early supporters:
👨‍🚀-10% Discount👨‍🚀 

[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=Vh1uVNN-OzA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]🚀The Hunt Begins[/h3]
Undertake dangerous missions and challenge other players and in exchange freely scavenge the planets. You can join forces with other players, but be careful, hunting down other players to seize their valuable equipment is also an option! Going on an expedition comes with a high reward if you find valuable items, but it’s also high risk - if you die, you lose everything!

[h3]🔨Gather Resources and Craft[/h3]
Collect resources such as gases, liquids, metals, and others on different planets. Each of the resources has its special gathering tool. Use the collected items to craft new and better equipment. The Mothership provides you with crafting stations, on which you can craft inhalers, weapon parts, ammo and more. Do you want to store them, sell for good money, or trade with other players? The choice is yours!

[h3]🔫Manage and Upgrade your Equipment[/h3]
Gather a diverse range of weapons: pistols, rifles, rocket launchers, machine guns, shotguns, and snipers. Upgrade stats and customize them with elemental modifications: fire, plasma, electricity, and acid. Beware of other players lurking on the planets for your loot. To avoid being left with nothing, store some of them in your storage room to be ready for your next expedition.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/
[hr][/hr]

✍️We are looking forward to your reviews and feedback. Once you buy the game, please do not hesitate to share your first impressions and leave an honest review on Steam. Your reviews are very valuable to us and we would love to see your remarks and first impressions through a review. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.

Join our amazing community in our [url=discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/AstroHuntersVR]X[/url] to share your experience and get to know other Hunters

Enjoy the game!

[b]Wenkly Studio Team[/b]

Become one of the mercenaries called Hunters and help the Mothership achieve its objectives on the hostile planets. Undertake dangerous missions and challenge other players and in exchange freely scavenge the planets. You can join forces with other players, but be careful, hunting down other players to seize their valuable equipment is also an option! Going on an expedition comes with a high reward if you find valuable items, but it’s also high risk - if you die, you lose everything you have with you!

[h3]🔨Gather Resources and Craft[/h3]
Collect resources such as gases, liquids, metals, and others on different planets. Each of the resources has its special gathering tool. Use the collected items to craft new and better equipment. The Mothership provides you with crafting stations, on which you can craft inhalers, weapon parts, ammo and more. Do you want to store them, sell for good money, or trade with other players? The choice is yours!

[h3]🔫Manage and Upgrade your Equipment[/h3]
Gather a diverse range of weapons: pistols, rifles, rocket launchers, machine guns, shotguns, and snipers. Upgrade stats and customize them with elemental modifications: fire, plasma, electricity, and acid. Beware of other players lurking on the planets for your loot. To avoid being left with nothing, store some of them in your storage room to be ready for your next expedition.

[h3]⏳ Join the Countdown[/h3]
Don't forget to wishlist the game and join the amazing community in our [url=discord.gg/yTMDg7xgeC]Discord[/url] to begin counting down to launch day! We are beyond excited to share in our excitement with all of you.

See you at launch!
- Wenkly Studio

notes.title: Dev Update #5
notes.notes:
Hello Astro Hunters!🚀

[previewyoutube=Vh1uVNN-OzA;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]
It's time for another update from the development of our game. We are excited to share the latest advancements and improvements we've been working on. Recently, our game was featured in the UploadVR Summer Showcase, so our team also worked on the video ➡️

Also, our free demo was available during Steam Next Fest. Thank you to everyone who played our demo and provided invaluable feedback and suggestions. Your input helps us make the game even better!


Don't forget to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b] and stay tuned for more exciting developments!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715910/Astro_Hunters_VR/

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Weapon Handling[/h3]
Our team worked on weapon handling. You can now throw away weapons, switch them between hands, and perform awesome tricks! When you discard a weapon, it automatically disappears from your inventory. However, if you pick it up and place it on your belt or behind your back (as you put all the resources), it will seamlessly return to your inventory. Additionally, when you pick up a weapon, the corresponding magazine will automatically appear on your belt.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_030ae3ef4d114e99b192be4a35badd83~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]Inventory System[/h3]
Our team has also been working on limited inventory. It is now divided into new categories and each category has its limits. This means you'll need to carefully choose what to bring on expeditions, leaving room to collect resources on the planet. But don’t worry—there's a perfect place for all your loot!

[h3]Storage Room[/h3]
Yes, here you will be able to store all your items! We’ve been hard at work on the Storage Room. From its design and graphics to its logic and mechanics. We hope you will like the result. Soon we will show you some sneak peeks on our social media and Discord.
 You can access your Storage Room from the Mothership. In the main room, there will be a control panel where you will be able to manage your storage rooms, unlock them, upgrade them to have more space, and buy new shelves. The rooms will be divided into: Resources, Crafting & Machinery, Storage and Armory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/7d683c85363d095a4b5d1923612bedf694de446b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Grenades[/h3]
Introducing grenades—something that wasn’t available during the demo! Each grenade has a unique effect. 
For now, four types of grenades are expected:
🔹Air Strike - starts a short air strike at the grenade blast location
🔹Healing Beacon - spawns a healing device that heals everyone around it
🔹Plasmatic Zone - a slowing zone ideal for closing choke-points
🔹Force Shield - a wall that blocks incoming damage
Players can take grenades from their tablet or directly from the wheel. We’re still fine-tuning the animations.

[h3]Crafting Stations[/h3]
Now, you can craft more than one item at once. That’s something we had on our to-do list and also this was something you asked for in the demo feedback. Before, only one item of a given type could be crafted at a time. Now, you can craft as many items as you have materials for. Don’t worry about using too many resources—the crafting station will automatically give you back any excess.
 
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/957014_6be7e405887f40b7b31420a9da2f1398~mv2.gif[/img]
[h3]What’s more?[/h3]
[list]
[*]Safe zones: We added safe zones next to the Crafting Stations and the Commander where you can freely take out your resources without worrying that somebody can steal them. They are separated by blue barriers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/f7cbd75cbc6f4b32b74181d189619ad8313f32da.jpg[/img]
[*]Sound enhancements: We've refined the sounds of footsteps, animals, enemies and crafting stations.
[*]New UI: A new user interface has been implemented in the capsule and also in the watch. While on the planet, your watch will now display the time remaining until capsule extraction. It will also show the remaining operating time of the inhaler when in use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783366/21ca6fde4dcdbe8071111bc0f6139e3f58221225.jpg[/img]
[/list] 
Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being part of this journey.
